body:
## Brief

This job reports a scheduler control-flow correction after a fatal accelerator error: retain a fatal state so later requests receive a restart-required response without another GPU dispatch. The original PR body was empty; this description restores provenance from the report already committed at the recorded head.

Original issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/38167
Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/968

## Evidence

The retained report records a failing-before/passing-after RPC probe and 34 focused unit tests. Read the exact commands, outputs and limitations in [the job report](https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/blob/7035931a1eee025b1847b58c531c583f983ea8a6/reports/j-e9765cab3f56/result.json). These are the job's claims and require independent review.

## Limitations

The reported RTX 5070 / WSL2 / CUDA 13.0 workload, model weights and LoRA were unavailable. No GPU model reproduction, memory-exhaustion diagnosis or change to disaggregated role transport is claimed. This remains an unmerged mirror PR.
